3: ## Overview
4: 
5: A single-user notes application for quickly creating, editing, and viewing text notes. All notes belong to a single shared space protected by a fixed password gate.
6: 
7: **Credentials**: Password is exactly `my-notes-are-mine` (case-sensitive, not changeable).
8: 
9: **Persistence**: Notes persist across browser sessions.
10: 
11: **Constraints**:
12: - No organization features (folders, tags, pinning)
13: - No rich text formatting (only plain text with line breaks)
14: - No attachments, exports, or imports
15: - No multi-user accounts or sync
16: 
17: ## Password Gate
18: 
19: On initial load or page reload, the app shows a password gate instead of notes.
20: 
21: **Behavior**:
22: - Single masked password field with an unlock action (button or Enter key)
23: - Empty submission shows validation error ("Password is required" or similar)
24: - Wrong password shows error ("Incorrect password" or similar) and remains on gate
25: - Correct password unlocks the app for the current browser tab session
26: - No note data (titles, previews, counts, timestamps) is visible before successful unlock
27: 
28: **Session Scope**:
29: - Unlock persists within the same tab during navigation between views
30: - Page reload or closing/reopening the tab re-locks the app
31: - Direct URLs to specific notes show the password gate first when locked
32: 
33: ## Notes List
34: 
35: After unlocking, the app shows a list of all notes (or empty state if none exist).
36: 
37: **Each note row displays**:
38: - **Title**: First non-empty line of the note body, trimmed of whitespace. If body is empty/whitespace-only, show placeholder like "New Note"
39: - **Preview**: Single-line snippet from the body following the title line, truncated with ellipsis if long
40: - **Timestamp**: Last edited time in exact format `YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm` (24-hour, UTC)
41: 
42: **Sorting**: Notes sorted by last edited timestamp, descending (most recent first).
43: 
44: **Actions**:
45: - Click a note row to open it in the editor
46: - "New Note" button creates a new note and opens the editor
47: 
48: ## Create & Edit Note
49: 
50: **Creating**: "New Note" creates a note with empty body and opens the editor. Cursor starts in the body text area.
51: 
52: **Editing**: Single text area for the note body. Line breaks preserved.
53: 
54: **Autosave**:
55: - Changes autosave when the user navigates away from the note (back to list or to another note)
56: - The last edited timestamp updates on each save
57: - No explicit Save button; autosave must guarantee text visible at navigation time is persisted
58: 
59: **Empty notes**: A note with empty body remains valid and listed (uses placeholder title).
60: 
61: ## Search
62: 
63: Search field above the notes list filters notes as the user types.
64: 
65: **Matching**: Case-insensitive substring match against title OR body.
66: 
67: **Behavior**:
68: - Filtered results maintain last-edited-time sort order
69: - Empty query shows all notes
70: 
71: ## Delete Note
72: 
73: Delete action available from both the list view and the editor view.
74: 
75: **Behavior**:
76: - Confirmation dialog required with messaging about permanent deletion
77: - Confirmed deletion immediately removes the note from all views (list, search results, editor)
78: - If deleted from editor, app navigates back to notes list
79: - Deletion is permanent; no trash, undo, or recovery
80: 
81: ## URL Behavior
82: 
83: Each note should have a stable URL that returns to the same note when opened again. All note URLs respect the password gate when locked.
